coaches.bio: Founder and visionary behind Infinity Taekwondo. Keo Moni has spent over a decade pushing the limits of World Taekwondo freestyle forms and high-difficulty tricking acrobatics. He leads tournament strategy and action choreography.
coaches.philosophy: Martial arts is not about destroying an opponent; it is the daily destruction of your own perceived limitations.

coaches.bio: A high-ranking 5th Dan Kukkiwon Master and national team poomsae coach. Master Sovan is renowned for his surgical eye in correcting stance angles, rhythmic breathing, and executing traditional forms with unyielding power.
coaches.philosophy: A mountain never shakes in the wind; in the same way, a true martial artist remains calm, rooted, and honorable under pressure.

coaches.bio: Specializing in youth martial development, Instructor Sothea combines playful motivation with rigorous martial discipline. He has coached over 150 junior students from white belt to regional championship podiums.
coaches.philosophy: Teach children discipline with patience and love, and they will grow into leaders who lift their communities.

coaches.bio: An explosive martial arts tricking athlete and demonstration captain. Kim Heng breaks down aerial twists, cheat-steps, corkscrews, and multi-target board breaks into safe, progressive drill progressions on Olympic spring floors.
coaches.philosophy: Gravity is only an obstacle until you understand the science of momentum and commitment.

coaches.bio: Holding a doctorate in Physical Therapy and Sports Kinesiology, Dr. Panha oversees our Human Performance Lab. He analyzes athlete joint kinematics, rate of force development, and constructs bulletproof injury pre-hab protocols.
coaches.philosophy: Do not train through dysfunction; correct the kinetic chain, and athletic power will flourish naturally.

coaches.bio: Veteran cinematographer and operations chief. ThaiPhirun leads our Sony Cinema camera rigs, lighting design, and live fight pre-viz filming, bringing the kinetic grace of Taekwondo to world-class broadcast screens.
coaches.philosophy: Every kick is a story of dedication; our cameras are simply the conduit to share that fire with the world.
